senses.gloss:
चोल mf. (-लः-ली) A short jacket, a bodice.
 m. (-लः) or m. plu. (-लाः) A
country, the modern Tanjore, the name is also supposed to apply
to a part of Birbhum in Bengal.
 E. चुल् to be high or to elevate,
affix अच् and ल being changed to ड चोड ut sup. or चोल a proper
name, that of the king of the country applied to the country, or
चुल कर्मणि घञ् ।

चोलक m. (-कः) A breastplate, a cuirass.
 n. (-कं) Bark, rind.
 E. चुल to
elevate, affix वुन्.

चोलकिन् m. (-की)
 1. The shoot of the bambu.
 2. The wrist.
 3. The
orange.
 4. A cuirassier, a soldier armed with a breastplate. E.
चोलक armour, rind, &c. and इनि aff.
चोलोण्डुक m. (-कः) A diadem, a fillet for the head, a turban or tiara.
चोलुक्य m. (-क्यः) One of the Rajarshis or royal saints.
